four_layer_diagnosis.claim_alignment: intact -- MECH-465's own assertion (conjunct 3, the residual-DV experiment) was not tested and the run never claims to. Of the claim's registered NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION conjunct (1), TWO of its THREE clauses -- commit rate at every urgency level in [0.05, 0.95], and median gate margin in [0.5, 2.0] on >= 50% of fresh ticks -- are met in 6 of 15 cells (WARM800/s0, PHASED400/s0, WARM200/s3, WARM400/s3, WARM800/s3, PHASED400/s3); the THIRD clause (urgency-off baseline commit rate in [0.2, 0.8]) is NOT measured by this design, which has no urgency-off arm (red-team F1). The informative clause is the commit-rate band: the margin clause is satisfied in 15/15 cells including the point-mass COLD cells, because the driver defines the threshold from the cell's own calibration median (thr = cal_median/(1+U_MID)), so margin ~1 is the calibration arithmetic, not a regime finding (red-team F2). Commit rate rises monotonically with urgency in 5 of the 6 band cells (WARM800/s0 0.13/0.38/0.59/0.77/0.86/0.93; PHASED400/s0 0.40/0.62/0.70/0.81/0.87/0.91; WARM400/s3 0.39/0.65/0.79/0.84/0.89/0.95); WARM200/s3 is graded but non-monotone (0.19/0.28/0.50/0.47/0.45/0.71) (red-team F3). The regime the lineage exists to find is present -- narrowly, on 2/3 seeds and 2/3 clauses -- in the run's own cells; the load-bearing bar that says otherwise is the one the claim's what_would_answer (revised 2026-09-01) forbids.
four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear -- LC-NE adaptive gain (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005; jepma2010 in targeted_review_connectome_mech_463). A biological decision threshold is set RELATIVE to the running statistics of its input; REE's commit gate is a FIXED absolute threshold (REEConfig.from_dims default 0.4 against a free-running rv median of 0.003-0.038, 10-120x apart), and the graded cells are exactly the ones where the driver recalibrated the threshold to the per-cell median on a WARMED z_world. e3_selector.py:822 returns config.commitment_threshold unchanged, so the post-construction override reaches the same gate the organism uses (red-team H, F10). The divergence is load-bearing for the substrate design, not for the claim.

four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: misleading -- (i) the load-bearing bar P2_BAR=0.51 is the 785a POOLED-across-seeds IQR/median, which MECH-465's what_would_answer (revised 2026-09-01, GFLAG-0056/0057) states 'MUST NOT be used as a per-seed bar ... SCORE IT PER SEED, and set the floor from within-seed data' -- and the very next sentence forbids the mirror move: 'Do NOT simply lower the floor to make it passable'; this driver (line 288, whose own comment calls it the '785a pooled figure'), the 2026-09-04 spike, the substrate entry and GFLAG-0136 all score it per seed. (ii) The driver's arithmetic premise ('graded once IQR/median is comparable to the +/-13% bracket') HOLDS -- the six band cells sit at 0.10-0.27, the bracket is 0.126 wide -- and only its trailing gloss 'i.e. as P2 approaches its bar' (equating ~0.13 with 0.51) is wrong (red-team F7). (iii) No per-seed floor separates in-band from out-of-band cells across seeds: seed 1 stays at 5/6 levels (misses u=0.04 at 0.03) at IQR/median 0.125, 0.152 and 0.179, while seed 0 reaches 6/6 at 0.101; gradedness at the lowest level tracks the LOWER TAIL of the rv trace (P(rv < 0.874 x median) 0.032 at WARM800/s0 vs 0.121 at WARM800/s1), not IQR/median (red-team F4). (iv) The record-only projection to the 0.51 bar (10.3 doublings from WARM800, CI [6.6, 32.2]) is a function of the invalid bar only.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: coupled -- z_world warmup -> e2 forward-model prediction error -> E3 running variance -> commit gate move together; PHASED400's P0b is an independent lever on rv dispersion in 2/3 seeds (C3: seed 0 ln-ratio 0.926 CI [0.565, 1.167]; seed 1 0.359 CI [0.007, 0.880], fragile; seed 3 -0.215 CI [-0.542, 0.074]).
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate for the question the cells answer; the budget lever is slow on the pooled slope (0.117/doubling; arm means 0.144, 0.131, 0.162 over WARM200/400/800) but climbing with confidence on seeds 0 and 1 and declining on seed 3.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-09 failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1015_2026-09-09, Fable cross-model red-team CONTESTED on assertions + routing, ten findings folded in] V3-EXQ-1015 (diagnostic, GFLAG-0136 warmup-budget sweep, FAIL, ree-cloud-2, 33 min) is non_contributory to MECH-465's assertion by design (conjunct 3 not run) and ADJUDICATED: the self-route p2_below_bar_trend_indeterminate is a frame error. Its load-bearing bar P2_BAR 0.51 is the 785a POOLED IQR/median that this claim's what_would_answer (2026-09-01) forbids as a per-seed bar (the driver's own comment calls it the '785a pooled figure'); the same bar is carried per seed by the 2026-09-04 spike, the substrate entry and GFLAG-0136, so the '2.7-5.8x shortfall' those cite (0.51/0.190, 0.51/0.088) is distance to a forbidden bar, not a shortfall. Scored against the claim's registered conjunct (1) instead: the commit-rate band clause (every urgency level in [0.05, 0.95]) holds in 6/15 cells -- seed 0 at WARM800 and PHASED400, seed 3 at every sweep budget -- with commit rate monotone in urgency in 5 of those 6 (e.g. 0.13->0.93, 0.40->0.91, 0.39->0.95; n 27-65 per level; WARM200/s3 graded but non-monotone). Seed 1 reaches 5/6 levels at every budget (u=0.04 at ~0.03). The gate-margin clause is met in 15/15 cells BY CONSTRUCTION (threshold calibrated to the cell's own median) and is not evidence; the urgency-off baseline clause was NOT measured (no OFF arm). Conjunct (2): the WWA's 'max 0.085 per seed' is stale -- within-seed IQR/median reaches 0.266 (WARM200/s3), 0.10-0.27 in the band cells -- but NO per-seed floor derived from these cells separates in-band from out-of-band across seeds (seed 1 fails at 0.125-0.179; seed 0 passes at 0.101), and the WWA forbids choosing a floor from the cells that pass; the lowest-level gradedness tracks the rv lower-tail mass (P(rv < 0.874 x median) 0.032 vs 0.121), not IQR/median, so the floor statistic itself may need re-specifying. Budget lever: pooled ln-gain 0.117/doubling (CI [0.037, 0.183]) = seeds 0 and 1 climbing with confidence (0.207, 0.211) plus seed 3 declining (-0.068); 6.6-32 doublings FROM WARM800 to 0.51 (~77,000 to 3e12 P0a episodes) -- impractically far from a bar that is invalid anyway; a WARM1600 rung is refused on both grounds. P0b e2-contrastive warmup is an independent lever (C3 2/3 seeds; seed 0 x2.5, seed 1 x1.4 with a CI lower bound of 0.007, seed 3 x0.8). Recalibration is necessary, not sufficient: recalibrated COLD gives 2/6, 3/6, 4/6 levels in band (seeds 0, 1, 3), never 6/6. Disposition: HOLD substrate_ceiling this cycle, flip to standard when the conjunct-3 experiment is queued; pending_retest_after_substrate -> false (no substrate build gates the experiment); resolve OPEN GFLAG-0238 with the THIRD option (neither extend nor accept: re-frame the bar and run conjunct 3); AMEND EXP-0590 (the existing conjunct-3 proposal, blocked_substrate on the 0.51-per-seed release condition) rather than minting a new proposal; append the 1015 record to MECH465-COMMIT-GATE-HEADROOM without superseding the route_retired item.

learning_extracted: A registered rule that lives in one claim field does not propagate: MECH-465's what_would_answer was corrected on 2026-09-01 (0.51 is POOLED; must not be scored per seed; do not simply lower the floor either) and three artifacts written after it -- the 2026-09-04 spike, GFLAG-0136, and this driver (whose own comment calls 0.51 the '785a pooled figure') -- score 0.51 per seed; the 2026-08-27 probe pre-registered it before the correction. The spike's '2.7-5.8x shortfall' and this run's C1 measure distance to a bar the claim forbids.

The driver's arithmetic premise is right and its gloss is wrong: graded commit response across the six urgency levels appears once within-seed IQR/median is comparable to the +/-13% bracket (0.10-0.27 in the six band cells), not 'as P2 approaches 0.51'. But no IQR/median floor derived from these cells separates seeds: seed 1 stays at 5/6 levels at 0.125-0.179 while seed 0 passes at 0.101; the lowest-level gradedness tracks the rv lower-tail mass (P(rv < 0.874 x median) 0.032 vs 0.121). The per-seed floor must be REGISTERED, not chosen from passing cells, and possibly re-specified as a tail statistic.

Two of conjunct (1)'s three clauses are measured here; the urgency-off baseline is not (no OFF arm), and the gate-margin clause passes in 15/15 cells by construction under per-cell recalibration. Only the commit-rate band clause carries information in this design.

The warmup-budget lever is climbing with confidence on seeds 0 and 1 (0.207, 0.211 ln-gain per doubling) and declining on seed 3 (-0.068); the pooled indeterminate label averages two climbs and a decline. Against 0.51 the climb is impractical (5.7-7.8 doublings on the climbing seeds; 10.3 [6.6, 32.2] pooled from WARM800, i.e. ~77,000 P0a episodes at the optimistic end); against any defensible per-seed floor the question is moot.

P0b e2-contrastive warmup on the warmed z_world is an independent lever on rv dispersion (C3 2/3 seeds with CI): seed 0 x2.5, seed 1 x1.4 (CI lower bound 0.007, fragile), seed 3 x0.8. Read with the disclosed asymmetry (PHASED400 accumulates residue over ~4000 P0b ticks).

Recalibration is necessary but not sufficient: the recalibrated COLD gate gives 2/6, 3/6 and 4/6 levels in band (a point-mass rv), never 6/6; the boundary regime needs BOTH a warmed z_world and a threshold set relative to the free-running median.

Biology divergence, load-bearing for the substrate: REE's commit threshold is a fixed absolute constant (from_dims default 0.4 vs free-running rv median 0.003-0.038) whereas biological gain control is relative to running input statistics; every '25-68x below the gate' figure in the MECH-463/465 lineage is a measurement of that constant. The '1.455x urgency bar' in the substrate entry is on the pre-2023589 sign (span now 1.288x).
